title: 2017 AMC 12A Problem 8
statement: The region consisting of all points in three-dimensional space within \(3\) units of line segment \(AB\) has volume \(216\pi.\) What is the length \(AB?\)

solutions.text:
Let \(h=AB.\) The region is a cylinder of radius \(3\) and height \(h\) with a hemisphere of radius \(3\) on each end.

The cylinder has volume \(\pi\cdot3^2\cdot h=9\pi h,\) and the two hemispheres together form a sphere of volume \(\dfrac{4}{3}\pi\cdot3^3=36\pi.\) So \[ 9\pi h+36\pi=216\pi, \] giving \(h=20.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
